description: Records that the founder filed the formation with the state themselves: the date the state accepted it, the state's filing number, and the uploaded stamped certificate (presign it with formation_get_formation_upload_url, kind STAMPED_CERTIFICATE, and PUT the PDF first). Only the formation's owner may call it; refused without the certificate. Moves the formation to FILING_IN_PROGRESS as self-reported, which the web, the tracker and every agent then read. Wyoming and Delaware only; refused for a formation Lovie is filing or has filed, and refused with a different number once one is recorded. Never call it for a formation Lovie is filing.
name: formation_record_state_filing
title: Record State Filing
